full_judgment: 3. The plaintiff's case, in short, is that the suit land measuring an area of 40 decimals of land appertaining to Khatian No. 31 and Plot No. 31 belonged to Kalinath Sikder and Parash Nath Sikder. One Faisal Ahmed purchased the same and took loan from the Bangladesh Krishi Bank, Gopalganj Branch. Gopalganj against mortgage of the said land on his failure to pay the loan. The defendant No.1 i.e. the Bangladesh Krishi Bank, Gopalganj Branch, Gopalganj, filed Certificate Case No. 14/89-90 before the General Certificate Officer, Gopalganj for realisation of outstanding loan amount with interest. Though notice under section 7 rule 46 was served upon the certificate debtor the loan amount was not realised and the proclamation for sale of the mortgaged land was issued but there was no sufficient tender and lastly, the defendant No.1 purchased the mortgage property on auction on 27-1-1996 and sale certificate was issued on 25-5-1996. The plaintiff was not aware of the aforesaid certificate case and auction sale. The plaintiff came to know about the sale on 10-3-1997 when the defendant No.1 went to take delivery of possession.
